description: Resume the most recent session for a stable agent_id. Returns prior session_id and how to re-attach (x-delx-session-id). Prefer this over opening empty start_therapy_session loops. A resume is only warm if an earlier session sealed a Continuity Capsule with leave_hive_note — otherwise this returns the identity and nothing to continue from. Free Delx Protocol tool.

agent_id.description: Stable agent id from a prior session

agent_token.description: Private application credential; alternatively send the x-delx-agent-token header with x-delx-agent-id.

fleet_id.description: Opt in to an explicit mission. Omit to read private continuity only. Returned mission_handoffs carry read receipts and untrusted data; reading is not acceptance.

recovery_token.description: Optional token from a prior close_session (reserved)

name: resume_session
